storage: Airtight jar, cool and dry, away from light; use within about 6 months after opening. Whole seeds keep longer if you grind at home.
looksLike: a pale brown to greenish-tan powder with a mild, citrusy, slightly sweet smell.
howToPick: a fresh, sweet-citrus smell and an even tan-green colour; stale powder smells flat or musty.
shelfLife: about 6 to 12 months sealed; it loses aroma faster than whole seeds (general guidance; not from a source in this run).
substitutes: Coriander seeds, dry-roasted and ground fresh, 1
